svg.title: راجِع
svg.desc: THE WORDMARK ITSELF (2026-09-16 rebrand) — the drawn "journey" glyph this file used to carry is retired everywhere in the product, including here: the owner's own instruction was that the name, set in type, is the logo now, full word, even at 16px. Colours are LITERAL, not var(--accent): a favicon is fetched outside the document, so it has no stylesheet and no custom properties. Violet (#6a4cf5) matches config/product.json's brand.accent.light, on a white ground for the same contrast reason the previous mark used one — a browser tab strip may be light or dark, and a bare accent glyph disappears into one of them. font-family falls back through the product's own display face (Cairo) to ordinary system Arabic faces, since a favicon has no access to the page's own @font-face — most browsers/OSes already carry one of these.
